title: CROSSFILTER BOTH on the customer relationship lets a product filter reach Customer
query: CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( Customer[Country] ), CROSSFILTER ( Customer[CustomerCode], Sales[CustomerCode], BOTH ) )
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Product], "Quantity", SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ), "Countries", [Different Countries Sold] )

source.quote: the relationship between the Customer and Sales tables filters in both directions
source.supports: the page defines this measure on these rows: during its evaluation the Customer relationship filters both ways

source.quote: If all expressions evaluate to BLANK for a row, that row is not included in the table returned
source.supports: the Hat has no sales: both expressions are BLANK and the row is removed

derivation: T-shirt (CL-01): Sales rows 1 and 3, Quantity 10 + 30 = 40, customers CUST-01 and CUST-02, countries United States and Australia: 2. Jeans (CL-02): row 2, Quantity 20, CUST-01: 1 country. Hat (AC-01): no Sales rows; Quantity is BLANK, and with both directions no customer remains, so DISTINCTCOUNT has no rows and is BLANK: the row is removed.
